name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Insurance aggregator wholly owned by Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi fintech that floated 30% of its shares on the Saudi Exchange's main market in 2024. Rasan's disclosed 5%+ holders are its founding individuals (prospectus table 1.2); IPO substantial holder Impact46, a private Saudi fund manager, exited entirely in March 2025. Nothing found.
note: Badge on the right chest of Al-Taawoun's 2026-27 home kit (club announcement and kit-launch photos, see issue #377); also present on several other Saudi shirts (front/back).
